meta.title: The Road Ahead
meta.description: KUL Enterprises plans fifty tractors by 2029. The plan in order, what has to happen first, and what does not change on the way. Licensed carrier in {location}, USDOT {usdot}.

opening.heading: Fifty tractors by 2029.
opening.body: Written in the order it has to happen, and nothing on it is dated until it is booked. The figures are updated the day they change.

leadFigure.label: Years driving
leadFigure.note: Eleven years hauling for other carriers before KUL took its first load.

facts.label: Under own authority
facts.note: The first load ran under KUL's own authority in 2026.

stages.title: The next tractor
stages.body: A tractor is added once there is repeat freight to keep it loaded through a full month. Until that is true the money stays in maintenance and insurance on the equipment already running.

stages.title: The next driver
stages.body: Hired on a verified work history and a clean motor vehicle record, held to the standards written on the safety page. Recruiting starts once the next tractor is booked, not before.

stages.title: Dispatch cover
stages.body: More people on the phone as the fleet grows, so calls are answered at any hour. The number on this site does not change when that happens.

fixed.heading: What does not change at any size
items: Dispatch stays reachable around the clock, at the same number, whatever the fleet size.
No load is accepted that cannot be run legally inside hours of service.
Delays come from us before they come from your receiver.

limits.heading: What this page is not
limits.body: There is no funding announcement here and no photographs of equipment KUL does not own. Nothing on it is a commitment to a customer.
